entities.name: UniProt Q6GZT8
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Frog virus 3 ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase large subunit; sequence length 565 aa.
Annotated EC 1.17.4.1; functions with the RNR small subunit to provide deoxyribonucleotides for viral DNA synthesis.
Reference annotation reports active-site positions 256, 258, and 260; position 258 forms a cysteine radical intermediate. These are reference numbering and sequence is an exact match.

entities.name: Ribonucleotide reduction
observations: Rhea RHEA:23252: 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + thioredoxin-disulfide + H2O = ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + thioredoxin-dithiol; enzyme annotation EC 1.17.4.1.

Physiologically, the reaction is understood in the reductive direction as ribonucleoside diphosphates converted to corresponding 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates, using reducing equivalents supplied by thioredoxin.
